// CASE multi_len_body_await expect=fire
async function m1(rows) {
	for (let i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(rows[i]);
	}
}

// CASE multi_len_body_push expect=fire
async function m2(ids) {
	const out = [];
	for (let i = 0, len = ids.length; i < len; i++) {
		out.push(await load(ids[i]));
	}
	return out;
}

// CASE multi_var_body expect=fire
async function m3(ids) {
	for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(ids[i]);
	}
}

// CASE multi_two_counters expect=fire
async function m4(a, b) {
	for (let i = 0, j = b.length - 1; i < j; i++, j--) {
		await swap(a[i], b[j]);
	}
}

// CASE multi_init_await_body_await expect=fire
async function m5() {
	for (let rows = await loadRows(), i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
		await save(rows[i]);
	}
}

// CASE single_decl_control expect=fire
async function m6(rows) {
	for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
		await save(rows[i]);
	}
}

// CASE multi_const_body expect=fire
async function m7(ids) {
	for (let i = 0, last = ids.length - 1; i <= last; i += 1) {
		const value = await load(ids[i]);
		use(value);
	}
}

// CASE empty_update_body expect=fire
async function m8(ids) {
	for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; ) {
		await save(ids[i]);
		i += 1;
	}
}

// CASE empty_init_body expect=fire
async function m9(ids) {
	let i = 0;
	for (; i < ids.length; i++) {
		await save(ids[i]);
	}
}

// CASE multi_assign_init_body expect=fire
async function m10(ids) {
	let i, n;
	for (i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(ids[i]);
	}
}
